messages.text: The stove counter in [[room:32|Galley|3]] broke down: it's down to 70%.
Lars Silva says you broke your promise to the residents to fix it (smell).
Lars Silva is waiting at the office: the residents want it fixed.
The water cooler in [[room:15|Site office|1]] broke down: it's down to 53%.
Lars Silva says you broke your promise to the residents to fix it (the home itself).
Lars Silva is waiting at the office: the residents want it fixed.
Supply drop landed: colonists 6, earth rations 125, water 186, metal 25, brick 10, machinery 3, electronics 3, soil 15.
Bradbury is ready for proper homes: studios and apartments, roomier than bunks.
Bradbury can build a brickworks: bricks from its own rock, not just Earth's.
Bradbury can build gyms and parks: somewhere to stay fit, and green space that cheers everyone near it.
Sana Reyes says you broke your promise to the residents to fix it (crowding).
Sana Reyes is waiting at the office: the residents want it fixed.
Milestone: fifty people.
Time to celebrate: fifty people: a decision is waiting.
A festival for fifty people! Lanterns are going up the shaft.
Dust storm forecast in about 3 months: charge the batteries, and expect little from the solar arrays while it blows.
The afterglow has faded in Bradbury: from now on, happiness is down to homes, quiet, health and comfort.
Still the same meal. Lars Silva is telling everyone you forgot about the galley.
Lars Silva says you broke your promise to the residents to fix it (smell).
Sana Reyes is waiting at the office: the residents want it fixed.

waiting.title: The residents want it fixed
waiting.text: Sana Reyes is back for the residents. "Smell reaching 3 homes, still. It's costing us 5 points of happiness. Smell rides the corridors: a bulkhead on the corridor between smelly rooms (galleys, farms, composters, recycling) and the homes stops it, and so does distance. Will you do something about it?"
